sections.content:
| # | Issue | File | Impact | Effort |
|---|-------|------|--------|--------|
| 1 | Sequential Yahoo Finance + DB writes | `refresh-prices/route.ts:30` | High (latency) | Low |
| 2 | `DataStreamNumber` setTimeout leak | `DataStreamNumber.tsx:69` | High (memory) | Low |
| 3 | 2 queries for latest/prev weight | `dashboard/home/route.ts:47` | Medium | Low |
| 4 | `fmtEuro` creates `Intl.NumberFormat` each call | Both clients | Medium | Trivial |
| 5 | `weightChartData` unmemoized | `DashboardHome.tsx:283` | Medium | Low |
| 6 | `force-dynamic` blocks all caching | All routes | Medium | Low |
| 7 | O(n×7) moving average | `dashboard/home/route.ts:115` | Low | Low |
| 8 | Task filters unmemoized | `TachesClient.tsx:109` | Low | Low |

The highest-value fix right now is **#2** (real memory leak) and **#1** (N+1 that directly affects the refresh button's UX latency).
